General budget and large-cap laws follow from zero-transition labels and the image of the cycle incidence matrix. Every special case, sign and normalization were independently checked against 504 rational exhaustive dual cases and independently solved primal LPs (n=2..8) and six sharp bottleneck instances. Finite tests support but do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The central recent numerical issue is preventing global TV growth when correcting conservative cell means without changing interface data; a local sufficient Harten condition does not determine reachability. The result gives exact O(n) minimum achievable TV for any cap, sharp O(n) exact no-extra-variation cap determined by collective cyclic mass bottlenecks, and a quantified 2m-cell family whose worst necessary correction grows as m/(2 lambda) despite all single-cell defects being one. These facts guide feasibility diagnostics and explain collective obstructions that independently clipped corrections miss. The claim explicitly limits itself to the algebraic correction problem rather than promising a new time integration scheme.
